maria_pm: Quick heads-up: SecureLink (partner) is ready for marketplace listing. Need to validate SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and HSM/KMS attestation before we sign off. Can we run a full dry-run Wed 11am PT? :calendar:#newline#newlinenina_securelink: Wed 11am works. We'll expose SAML metadata + SCIM test tenant. Our HSM exposes PKCS#11 and an attestation service at https://securelink.example.com/attest. I'll DM certs.#newline#newlineraj_infra: Ops note: we'll run canary in dedicated for the dry-run, fallback to hosted API if anything fails. Please follow the runbook steps for federation rollback.#newline#newlinedave_devex: I'll script SCIM sync checks and share a small harness. Need attribute mapping from SecureLink (sample users).#newline#newlinena_securelink: Sending sample SCIM JSON now (DM) and posting SAML metadata at https://securelink.example.com/saml/metadata.xml. Metadata supports org-wide NameID and eduPersonPrincipalName.#newline#newlinemaria_pm: Great. Proposed SCIM mapping (for provisioning):#newline#newline````
{
  "id": "external_id",
  "userName": "email",
  "name": {"givenName": "first_name", "familyName": "last_name"},
  "emails": ["email"],
  "active": "active"
}
````#newline#newlineraj_infra: Sandbox limits: SCIM 40 req/s, create batch size 200 with 3s pause to be safe. SAML SSO smoke: try single-idp login before bulk provisioning.#newline#newlineci-bot: Reminder: test environment snapshot will be created Tue 22:00 PT — expect 10-15m maintenance window.#newline#newlinemaria_pm: KMS/HSM test plan (non-prod): wrap/unwrap flow and attestation validation. Example wrap call (test):#newline#newline````
# wrap test using staging KMS
curl -X POST https://kms-staging.rwinf/wrap -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"plaintext":"test-data"}'
# unwrap
curl -X POST https://kms-staging.rwinf/unwrap -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"cipher":"..."}'
# send attestation blob to infra endpoint
curl -X POST https://infra.rwinf/attest -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" --data-binary @attest.bin
````#newline#newlinenina_securelink: Attestation blob uploaded to Confluence and SHA256: f2c4a9b8... . Device firmware v3.2.1. Attestation service supports TPM2 quote + X.509 chain.#newline#newlineraj_infra: I'll validate the quote against our root CA and test keywrap with a test key. If it passes, we move to canary cluster deploy Thu morning.#newline#newlinedave_devex: I'll post the SCIM harness (Python) in the runbook repo + instructions to run incremental sync and verify group memberships. Will include expected diffs sample.#newline#newlinelegal-bot: Legal: embargo window requested. Please attach proposed announcement copy to this thread. We need at least 48h review prior to public release.#newline#newlinemaria_pm: Draft announcement will be uploaded Tue 9am. Target embargo lift Fri 08:00 PT. Any objections?#newline#newlinenina_securelink: Works for SecureLink. Will provide logo SVG and co-author blurb by Tue 10am.#newline#newlineraj_infra: Rollback plan: (1) disable federation (2) disable SCIM provisioning (3) rotate integration keys if HSM test fails. Documented in runbook.#newline#newlineci-bot: sandbox capacity check scheduled Wed 10:30 PT — no conflicts currently noted.#newline#newlinemaria_pm: Action items (summary):#newline#newline- nina_securelink: host SAML metadata, provide SCIM samples, upload attestation blob and logos#newline#newline- dave_devex: SCIM test harness + instructions (repo link)#newline#newline- raj_infra: attestation validation, keywrap tests, canary deploy plan#newline#newline- legal-bot: embargo review + signoff#newline#newline- maria_pm: draft announcement + coordinate calendar invites#newline#newlinemaria_pm: Dry-run Wed 11am PT confirmed. I'll send invite and include runbook + links. Please RSVP and attach any precheck logs to the calendar event.#newline#newlinenina_securelink: RSVP'd. Looking forward to it :thumbsup:#newline#newlineraj_infra: On it. Will post verification checklist in runbook before Wed.#newline#newlinedave_devex: Uploaded SCIM harness to repo and linked in runbook. Small note: the harness retries 429s with exponential backoff by default.#newline#newlinemaria_pm: Perfect. If no further comments I'll lock this thread and move discussion into calendar invite thread. Thanks all!
